applicationStart: cd /root/code_deploy_application && npm install && { nohup node scripts/start-dev.mjs --port 8080 >> /root/application.log 2>&1 & APP_PID=$!; echo $APP_PID > /root/application.pid; sleep 2; kill -0 $APP_PID; }
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill $(cat /root/application.pid) 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
